title: Conflict Complicates Environmental Problems at the Dead Sea
titleZh: 冲突令死海环境问题更为复杂
credits: Ruth Eglash reported this story for Agence France-Presse (AFP). John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: International visitors to Israel used to visit Ein Gedi, a popular beach on the Dead Sea.
sentences.zh: 以色列的国际游客过去常去死海边的恩盖迪，那是一个热门的海滩。

sentences.en: The Dead Sea is the place on Earth’s surface that is farthest below sea level.
sentences.zh: 死海是地球表面上海拔最低的地方。

sentences.en: Now, the beautiful desert area is in ruins beside the shrinking, salty lake.
sentences.zh: 如今，这片美丽的沙漠地区却在一片废墟之中，旁边是不断缩小、盐分极高的湖泊。

sentences.en: The beach has been closed to the public for five years, mainly because of the appearance of dangerous holes in the ground.
sentences.zh: 这片海滩已对公众关闭五年，主要是因为地面上出现了危险的坑洞。

sentences.en: These holes, known as sinkholes, are caused by the collapse of the surface layer.
sentences.zh: 这些坑洞被称为陷坑，是由地表层的坍塌造成的。

sentences.en: The beach has been closed because the drop in the sea's level has made it difficult to reach its waters.
sentences.zh: 海滩被关闭，是因为海水水位下降，使得人们难以到达海边。

sentences.en: These environmental changes are not new.
sentences.zh: 这些环境变化并非新事。

sentences.en: The Dead Sea, where Israeli, Jordanian and Palestinian territory meet, has been dying for years.
sentences.zh: 死海位于以色列、约旦和巴勒斯坦领土交汇处，多年来已濒临消亡。

sentences.en: With the current conflict in the Middle East, efforts to deal with the environmental problem have disappeared too.
sentences.zh: 随着中东当前冲突的爆发，应对这一环境问题的努力也随之消失。

sentences.en: Nadav Tal of the Israel office of Eco Peace, a non-profit group, told the French News Agency (AFP), "Regional cooperation is the key... to saving the Dead Sea."
sentences.zh: 非营利组织“生态和平”以色列办公室的纳达夫·塔尔向法新社（AFP）表示：“区域合作是……拯救死海的关键。”

sentences.en: Tal added: "Because we are living in a conflict area, there is an obstacle."
sentences.zh: 塔尔补充道：“由于我们身处冲突地区，因此存在障碍。”

sentences.en: Tal described how the sea has been declining more than one meter per year since the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 塔尔描述了自20世纪60年代以来，死海每年以超过一米的速度下降。

sentences.en: The evaporation of the salty waters takes place partly because temperatures reach up to 50 degrees Celsius in the summer.
sentences.zh: 盐水的蒸发部分是因为夏季气温高达50摄氏度。

sentences.en: The sea has also been affected by years of increasing water usage from the sea's main source, the Jordan River, and other smaller waterways which begin in Lebanon and Syria.
sentences.zh: 死海还受到多年来对其主要水源约旦河以及发源于黎巴嫩和叙利亚的其他较小水道用水量增加的影响。

sentences.en: Local factories also use the water to get minerals -- potash, bromine, sodium chloride, and magnesium chloride, among others.
sentences.zh: 当地工厂也利用这些水源来提取矿物——包括钾碱、溴、氯化钠和氯化镁等。

sentences.en: Tal told AFP, "The consequences of this water diversion is what we see around us.”
sentences.zh: 塔尔对法新社说：“这种引水行为所带来的后果，正是我们眼前所看到的。”

sentences.en: He described it as an “ecological disaster," adding that "the declining of the Dead Sea is a disaster for Israeli tourism."
sentences.zh: 他将其描述为一场“生态灾难”，并补充说“死海的萎缩是以色列旅游业的一场灾难。”

sentences.en: Efforts to deal with the Dead Sea disaster include past agreements signed by Israel and Jordan.
sentences.zh: 应对死海灾难的努力包括以色列和约旦此前签署的各项协议。

sentences.en: But the wars taking place in Gaza and beyond have brought tensions to an all-time high.
sentences.zh: 但在加沙及更广泛地区爆发的战争已将紧张局势推至历史高点。

sentences.en: As a result, cross-border environmental issues are no longer getting attention.
sentences.zh: 因此，跨境环境问题不再受到关注。

sentences.en: At Israel's environment ministry, Ohad Carny has been working on the Dead Sea issue for years.
sentences.zh: 在以色列环境部，Ohad Carny多年来一直从事死海问题的研究。

sentences.en: He said the government was looking into several solutions.
sentences.zh: 他表示，政府正在研究多种解决方案。

sentences.en: They include building a desalination factory and making a canal from either the north or the south to deal with water shortages in the area including the Dead Sea.
sentences.zh: 这些方案包括建造一座海水淡化厂，并从北部或南部开凿一条运河，以应对包括死海在内的该地区的水资源短缺问题。

sentences.en: But, he said, "It doesn't make economic or environmental sense to desalinate water and bring it directly to the Dead Sea, because then it's a waste of drinking water and the region needs…more drinking water and more water for agriculture.”
sentences.zh: 但是，他表示，"将海水淡化后直接输送到死海，在经济上和环境上都是说不通的，因为那样做会浪费饮用水，而该地区需要更多的饮用水和更多的农业用水。"

sentences.en: Carny said that his attention was on the Israeli side.
sentences.zh: Carny表示，他的关注点在于以色列方面。

sentences.en: But he added, "We can't do it alone.
sentences.zh: 但他补充道，"我们不能单独完成这件事。

sentences.en: It must be a joint effort.
sentences.zh: 这必须是一项共同努力。

sentences.en: So only time will tell, and we won't do anything without an agreement together with the Jordanian side."
sentences.zh: 所以只有时间能给出答案，而且如果没有与约旦方面达成协议，我们不会采取任何行动。"

sentences.en: Back at the Dead Sea, 40-year-old bus driver Benny is at a place where people can still visit.
sentences.zh: 回到死海，40岁的巴士司机Benny来到了一个人们仍然可以参观的地方。

sentences.en: Benny was getting some winter sun at one of the warm sinkhole pools.
sentences.zh: Benny正在一个温暖的陷落坑池中享受着冬日的阳光。

sentences.en: He said the sea's changes were difficult.
sentences.zh: 他表示，大海的变化令人难以接受。

sentences.en: "But everything has a plus and minus.
sentences.zh: "但凡事都有利有弊。

sentences.en: Because of what is happening here, we have water spots like this one."
sentences.zh: 由于这里所发生的一切，我们才有了像这样的水坑。"

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是John Russell。"
